poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Take a palms-up grip wider than your shoulders and let your arms hang long.

poses.label: Curl
poses.description: Curl toward your chest with your upper arms steady and the bar level.

poses.label: Top
poses.description: Finish near your chest without leaning back or bringing your elbows forward.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower under control all the way to the start.

checks: Compared grip, setup, range, and return with the catalog cue and reference.
Validated contacts, framing, and limb lengths across interpolated poses.
limitations: Palm orientation is conveyed by the cue and grip metadata. The renderer does not draw individual finger or wrist orientation.
Phone playback and admin review are pending.
